name: Camp Tel Noar
description_short: A small, co-ed Jewish overnight camp in Hampstead, New Hampshire, founded in 1945. Sessions are 2, 3.5, or 7 weeks long, and campers choose their own activities and electives.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page mentions a pool for swimming and a lake for paddling. It gives no details on swim instruction or lifeguard staffing.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is the camp's overview page. Session dates and tuition are on a separate page (https://www.cohencamps.org/tel-noar/summer/dates-tuition/) that was not provided, so no sessions were recorded.
The page says Opening Day 2027 is 'Wednesday, June 23' and enrollment is open, but it does not say which session starts that day.
The Cohen Camps runs several camps (Tel Noar, Tevya, Pembroke), and the site footer covers all of them.
